title: Ad creative testing: plan tests that tell you what works
seoTitle: Ad creative testing: how to plan fair tests
description: Plan ad creative testing that gives real answers. Test one idea at a time, size the test with example figures, read Meta's results and keep a log.
lede: Good ad creative testing changes one idea at a time, starts from a written hypothesis and runs long enough to beat luck. This guide shows what to test first and how to size a test using labelled example figures. It also explains how to read Meta's results and how to keep a useful test log.
